verdict.rationale: Airwallex provides financial data and reconciliation building blocks (Card Expenses API for ERP sync, Bills API for AP, webhooks) plus AgentOS, an AI-agent toolkit explicitly described as building cashflow reports and reading balances, which supports faster reconciliation/closing workflows. But it is not itself an accounting/bookkeeping platform with a defined 'close the books' automation, and it never names integrations with major accounting software (QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite) to complete the loop. Missing for 10: an explicit month-end close automation feature, named accounting-software integrations, and evidence of AI agents autonomously performing reconciliation end-to-end.
